# Dashboard

> Your latest audit score, most important pages, search rankings, AI visibility and backlinks — the whole picture on one screen.

## Pages

- [Dashboard — your site health at a glance](https://site-optimizer.vercel.app/): Your latest audit score, most important pages, search rankings, AI visibility and backlinks — the whole picture on one screen.
- [AI visibility in answer engines · SiteChecker](https://site-optimizer.vercel.app/ai-visibility): Whether ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google’s AI answers can reach, read and understand your website — with the fixes, in order.
- [Your website projects · SiteChecker](https://site-optimizer.vercel.app/projects): Every website you audit, as one project — with its latest health score and trend across all crawls.
- [Track your search rankings · SiteChecker](https://site-optimizer.vercel.app/ranks): See where your website shows up in search for any phrase, in any city, on computer or phone — and watch how your position changes over time.
- [Search & traffic insights · SiteChecker](https://site-optimizer.vercel.app/insights): See what people search to find you, which pages bring the most visits, and how your search results are performing.
- [Backlink monitoring & lost-link alerts · SiteChecker](https://site-optimizer.vercel.app/backlinks): Track the links pointing to your site: which are still live, which are dofollow, and which have disappeared — with alerts on the ones worth chasing.
- [Content quality, page by page · SiteChecker](https://site-optimizer.vercel.app/content): An AI editor reads your pages and scores them on depth, originality and expertise — the things search engines actually reward.
- [Scheduling, alerts & integrations · SiteChecker](https://site-optimizer.vercel.app/schedule): Set up automatic re-crawls and alerts, connect Search Console and Analytics, and see what is configured — run from a laptop or free on a schedule.
- [Audit of site-optimizer.vercel.app · a6d128 · SiteChecker](https://site-optimizer.vercel.app/crawl/a6d12810-2ff3-444d-ad36-ee63039a2116): Technical health 40/100 for site-optimizer.vercel.app — 29 issues found across 25 pages.
- [Audit history for site-optimizer.vercel.app · SiteChecker](https://site-optimizer.vercel.app/project/1): Audit history for site-optimizer.vercel.app: health over time, every failing check across crawls, and what changed since the first audit.
- [Robots & sitemap · site-optimizer.vercel.app · SiteChecker](https://site-optimizer.vercel.app/crawl/a6d12810-2ff3-444d-ad36-ee63039a2116/manage): Review and clean up the robots file and XML sitemaps for site-optimizer.vercel.app — problems are detected and a corrected file is generated for you to copy.
- [Compare audits · site-optimizer.vercel.app · SiteChecker](https://site-optimizer.vercel.app/crawl/a6d12810-2ff3-444d-ad36-ee63039a2116/compare): How site-optimizer.vercel.app changed between audits: score, pages and issues over time, plus the checks fixed or newly broken since the previous crawl.
